name: self.mp3
description: A private music library you actually own. Import, tag, sync to your phone, listen offline.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/shared && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/cloud && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/client && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/server && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/web
scripts.typecheck:mobile: npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/shared && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/cloud && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/client && npm run typecheck --workspace @selfmp3/mobile
scripts.check:mobile: npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run lint:mobile
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/shared && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/cloud && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/client && npm run start --workspace @selfmp3/mobile
scripts.dev:cloud: npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/shared && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/cloud && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/client && VITE_CLOUD=1 VITE_BASE=/selfmp3/ npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/web && VITE_BASE=/selfmp3/ npm run preview --workspace @selfmp3/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist apps/*/dist apps/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
